# Temper Docs

Temper is a mobile gym tracking app. These docs describe public formats that external tools can use to create Temper-compatible data.

## Program Import

Use Temper Program Import Format v1.0 to generate workout programs that can be imported into the Temper mobile app.

- Guide: https://kyle-pierce.github.io/temper-docs/program-import/
- JSON Schema: https://kyle-pierce.github.io/temper-docs/program-import/schema.json
- Prompt Template: https://kyle-pierce.github.io/temper-docs/program-import/prompt.md
- Example Upper/Lower Program: https://kyle-pierce.github.io/temper-docs/program-import/examples/upper-lower.json
- Example Push/Pull/Legs Program: https://kyle-pierce.github.io/temper-docs/program-import/examples/push-pull-legs.json
- Example Full Body Program: https://kyle-pierce.github.io/temper-docs/program-import/examples/full-body-3-day.json
